passages.title: SEBI PR No. 14/2026 - Caution to Investors on Stock Market Scams through Account Handling Services
passages.text: SEBI PR No. 14/2026 - Caution to Investors on Stock Market Scams through Account Handling Services
passages.note: Official SEBI PR 14/2026 (26 Feb 2026), PDF fetched 2026-10-04 (page: sebi.gov.in/media-and-notifications/press-releases/feb-2026/...account-handling-services_100030.html). It does NOT say 'do not pay money' in those words. Previously cited via a taxguru.in reproduction (T2).

passages.title: Customer Protection - Limiting Liability of Customers in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions (RBI/2017-18/15, 6 July 2017)
passages.text: Customer Protection - Limiting Liability of Customers in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions (RBI/2017-18/15, 6 July 2017)
passages.note: Fetched 2026-10-04 from rbi.org.in. Para 5: customers should notify the bank of an unauthorised electronic transaction at the earliest; the longer the delay, the higher the risk of loss; on a report the bank must take immediate steps to prevent further unauthorised transactions. Supports only 'contact your bank promptly'. It covers UNAUTHORISED electronic transactions; it does not say a payment the customer made themselves is refundable, and it does not cover reporting a cybercrime.

passages.title: Citizen Financial Cyber Frauds Reporting and Management System (For Delhi Only)
passages.text: Citizen Financial Cyber Frauds Reporting and Management System (For Delhi Only)
passages.note: Official manual linked from cybercrime.gov.in/Webform/Citizen_Manual.aspx (page 'Last Updated 02/02/2024'); document date not stated, so date_of_source records the fetch date. Names what to provide when reporting on 1930 or the portal: mobile number, bank/wallet debited, account/UPI ID debited, transaction ID, transaction date, card number if a card was used, and a screenshot if available. The document is headed 'For Delhi Only', so its nationwide scope is UNVERIFIED. It does not mention keeping chat history or phone numbers.

passages.title: BE(A)WARE - A Booklet on Modus Operandi of Financial Fraudsters (RBI, March 2022)
passages.text: BE(A)WARE - A Booklet on Modus Operandi of Financial Fraudsters (RBI, March 2022)
passages.note: Fetched 2026-10-04 from rbidocs.rbi.org.in. Part A s.2 (Vishing calls): bank officials / financial institutions / RBI / any genuine entity never ask customers to share username, password, card details, CVV or OTP; never share these with anyone. Supports only the credentials/OTP half of the claim; it does not say 'do not pay money because of this message'.

passages.title: BE(A)WARE - A Booklet on Modus Operandi of Financial Fraudsters (RBI, March 2022)
passages.text: BE(A)WARE - A Booklet on Modus Operandi of Financial Fraudsters (RBI, March 2022)
passages.note: Fetched 2026-10-04. Part A s.6 (screen sharing app / remote access): download such apps only when advised through the company's official toll-free number as on its official website; do not download if an executive contacts you from a personal number. s.4: never download an app from unknown sources or when guided by an unknown person. The booklet's wording is narrower than 'at a stranger's request'; it does not name AnyDesk or TeamViewer.

passages.title: BE(A)WARE - A Booklet on Modus Operandi of Financial Fraudsters (RBI, March 2022)
passages.text: BE(A)WARE - A Booklet on Modus Operandi of Financial Fraudsters (RBI, March 2022)
passages.note: Fetched 2026-10-04. Part A s.1 and s.8: always go to the official website of your bank / service provider; obtain customer-care contact details from official websites, not from search results or message links. The booklet does not literally say 'the number or app you already have'; it says official website.
